# Landspace acreage code, vendored

Unmodified copies of `apps/web/src/map/geo.js` (polygon area and perimeter on the sphere) and `apps/web/src/utils/format.js` (how the app prints acres and distances) from https://github.com/avemath/landspace at commit `c560da2`. The home page Landspace tile computes the acreage of a parcel you draw with these, on a made-up grid. Update both together if the repo changes.
